title: Resource trend
archiveDescription: Review long-term resource changes plus sustained pressure and recovery events across restarts.
saveOnDevice: Save aggregate history on this device
emptyDescription: Trends appear after the first valid sample; enable on-device saving to retain them across restarts.
throughputChartLabel: Historical disk and network throughput trend

stories.title: Computer stories
stories.description: Pairs alerts and recoveries into one incident, then explains its impact and outcome in plain language.
stories.cause: Main cause: {{name}} had the highest impact at the time
stories.emptyDescription: CoreRobin ignores brief fluctuations and only records conditions that persist long enough to affect the computer.

active.title: The computer is staying busy
active.description: Processor load has stayed high for {{duration}}, peaking near {{value}}%. The computer may feel slow, warm, or use more battery.

recovered.title: The computer was busy and has recovered
recovered.description: The high load lasted about {{duration}}, peaked near {{value}}%, and then returned to the normal range.

cpu.guidance: If the computer still feels slow, open Applications to see the biggest impact. CoreRobin never closes an app automatically.

active.title: Available memory is getting tight
active.description: Low available memory and swap activity have continued for {{duration}}. Switching apps may feel slower.

recovered.title: Memory pressure rose and has eased
recovered.description: Memory stayed tight for about {{duration}}, then available memory and swap activity recovered.

memory.guidance: High memory use alone is normal. CoreRobin records this only when low availability and meaningful swap activity happen together.

active.title: Disk free space is running low
active.description: Disk usage has stayed above the reminder level for {{duration}}, reaching about {{value}}%.

recovered.title: Disk space pressure has eased
recovered.description: Disk space was tight for about {{duration}} and is now below the reminder level.

volume.guidance: Open Cleanup to inspect the space map first. Every file action still requires your confirmation.

alerts.title: Alert and recovery events
alerts.description: Alerts require sustained High readings; recovery hysteresis and cooldown reduce spikes and repeated events.
alerts.emptyDescription: Brief spikes are ignored. Sustained pressure and recovery events will appear here.

actions.title: Actions and results
actions.description: Keeps the operations you confirmed and verifies their outcome when possible.
actions.emptyDescription: Results will appear here after you close an app, clean files, or manage a startup item.

verification.not_confirmed: Final state could not be confirmed yet

privacyLocal: History stays in this device's CoreRobin WebView storage and is never uploaded or synchronized.
privacyCollected: History stores aggregate resource snapshots, pressure and recovery events, plus the type, result, item count, and reclaimed space of actions you confirm. App or startup item names are saved only after you allow them separately in Settings.
privacyExcluded: Process commands, users, paths, file names, and local or remote connection addresses are not stored.
privacyControl: Disabling stops new writes; existing records remain until they expire or you clear them manually.
